author: Melissa Moon
title: Man's skull crushed by angry group after Midtown car crash - NewsBreak
text:
By Melissa Moon No media credit provided. ,
4 hours ago MEMPHIS, Tenn. — A Memphis bartender says an angry group of men beat him and crushed his skull after he rear-ended their car on a Midtown street.
The victim, who wanted to remain anonymous, said the car accident happened on October 18 at Idlewild and Union. He said it was raining at the time, and when he got out of his car to exchange insurance information, he was attacked and knocked unconscious.
“They seem pretty mad about it. When they got out of the car, they were yelling at me. I was just dazed and looking at my phone, and there were just like six guys surrounding me, and then one of them hit me, and then I remember going to the ground and then waking up in an ambulance.”
A man was treated for a fractured skull after being attacked by a group of men on October 18. Submitted photo A witness told police she saw at least six males repeatedly punch and kick the man before leaving in a white vehicle.
The victim thinks he was pistol-whipped on the head. He said he suffered a fractured skull, a broken orbital bone, and a crushed sinus cavity and needed surgery to put pieces of his skull back together.
“They put titanium plates in or this titanium mesh thing to hold my skull back together essentially,” he said. “My head hurts. I’ve got about 40 to 50 staples going from ear to ear over the top of my head.”
Man’s skulled crushed in attack. Submitted photo.l Man’s skulled crushed in attack. Submitted photo.l Man’s skulled crushed in attack. Submitted photo. The man’s car was totaled in the crash, and because of his injuries, he has been unable to return to work. A family member has created a GoFundMe page to help with his expenses.
The victim said the men who beat him took his cell phone. He said it’s possible the vehicle he hit was also stolen.
30 block of Idlewild Street “I think they were mad. I may have spoiled their joy ride. I don’t know. It happened so fast. From the time of me getting out of the car to me being hit was less than a minute or two.”
The suspects are still on the run. If you know anything about the incident, call CrimeStoppers at 901-528-CASH. For information about the GoFundMe, click here.
